reason: A native AWS Graviton (m7g, aarch64) joined a running k3s v1.35.5+k3s1 + Cilium cluster over a mesh as a Ready arm64 node alongside the amd64 nodes, one control plane. The node's arm64 Cilium agent ran and cleared node.cilium.io/agent-not-ready; the node was pre-tainted at registration so nothing production could drift onto it. This is the first mixed amd64/arm64 open-infra cluster.
evidence_ref: runtime 2026-08-28 (AWS Graviton m7g on a live cluster)

reason: GATING test: a pod on the arm64 node resolved cluster DNS via CoreDNS, reached the apiserver ClusterIP :443, and reached the in-cluster MinIO ClusterIP :9000 health endpoint (HTTP 200) — all over the mesh. Cilium's BPF datapath carries pod->Service traffic between the arm64 node and the amd64 control plane, so a stateless kind on arm64 can reach its data-plane dependencies. If this had failed, real kinds would schedule-then-fail at runtime; it passed.
evidence_ref: runtime 2026-08-28 (AWS Graviton m7g on a live cluster)

reason: The per-node arch-pin composition (test/render) asserts that annotating a Query with openinfra.dev/arch: arm64 renders BOTH the -arm64 image (open-infra-query:latest-arm64) AND a kubernetes.io/arch: arm64 nodeSelector; the default (no annotation) renders the amd64 :latest image + arch: amd64. TestQuery_ImageArchSuffix, TestQuery_ArchAnnotationOverride, TestDatabaseProxy_ImageArchSuffix all PASS.

Front-to-back: an arm64 first-party image (open-infra-query:latest-arm64), placed on the arm64 node by the arch nodeSelector, ran the DuckDB engine, connected to the in-cluster MinIO by ClusterIP over the mesh, read a real CSV object, and returned the correct aggregation (3 rows, sum 60). Full chain: schedule -> pull arm64 image -> run engine -> reach cross-mesh data dependency -> correct result. (DuckDB note for a raw job: httpfs is bundled under the default HOME so don't override it; credential_chain/aws hangs probing EC2 IMDS + can't INSTALL onto the RO rootfs -> use bundled httpfs + explicit SET s3_* creds, which is what the composition's runner does.)
evidence_ref: runtime 2026-08-28 (AWS Graviton m7g on a live cluster)

reason: Negative/safety case: a workload pinned kubernetes.io/arch: arm64 with no toleration for the node's taint went Pending with the scheduler verdict '0/N nodes are available: ... didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector ... untolerated taint(s)' -- it could not fall onto any amd64 node. The arch nodeSelector is a hard constraint, so a wrong-arch image can never be scheduled onto the wrong-arch node.
evidence_ref: runtime 2026-08-28 (AWS Graviton m7g on a live cluster)

reason: The #41 arch-satisfiability admission is live and evaluating on the mixed cluster: the ValidatingAdmissionPolicy openinfra-arch-satisfiable + its binding + the crossplane-system/openinfra-kind-satisfiable param ConfigMap (26 kinds) + the kind-satisfiable CronJob (every 5 min) are all present. On a mixed cluster every kind is satisfiable (both arches present) so it allows; the fail-closed refusal was separately proven on an arm64-only cluster.
evidence_ref: runtime 2026-08-28 (AWS Graviton m7g on a live cluster)

reason: open-infra runs as a mixed amd64/arm64 cluster: per-cluster arch tag-selection (imageArchSuffix, #112) is shipped and a per-node arch pin (validated, landing) routes each kind to a node its image can run on. End-to-end proven front-to-back on a live mixed cluster (substrate, cross-mesh data path, composition render+run, isolation, admission all green). This is durable cloud arm64 (AWS Graviton), not a borrowed dev VM.
evidence_ref: runtime 2026-08-28 (AWS Graviton m7g on a live cluster)

reason: Not proven here, by design: (1) VM arch safety -- an explicit arch nodeSelector on VirtualMachine so a Windows VM is EXPLICITLY pinned off arm64 nodes is NOT built (today only KubeVirt q35 implicitly fails there); (2) stateful kinds on arm64 (a Database PVC) were out of scope -- the arm64 node had no distributed storage, so this covers stateless kinds that call back to in-cluster services; (3) the per-node arch pin is validated but still landing (not yet the default composition path) + needs rolling across the remaining compositions.
